name: io.github.dc28vivek/splittab
title: Splittab
description: An unofficial Splitwise MCP server. Explain balances, settle up, split receipts by item, and add expenses in a sentence. Every write previews who it affects and waits; nothing is ever deleted.

environmentVariables.name: SPLITWISE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own Splitwise API key, from https://secure.splitwise.com/apps. It stays on your machine and is sent only to Splitwise.

environmentVariables.name: SPLITTAB_STATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. A 32+ character secret used to sign the confirmation state passed between tool rounds. A random one is generated per process if unset, which is fine for a single local server.
